question.description: What to look for, in plain words.

configuration.query: FROM asked-archive METADATA _score | WHERE kind == "segment" AND MATCH(content, ?question) | SORT _score DESC | LIMIT 8 | EVAL seconds = (startMs / 1000) % 60, time = CONCAT(TO_STRING(startMs / 60000), ":", RIGHT(CONCAT("0", TO_STRING(seconds)), 2)) | KEEP sessionId, sessionTitle, speaker, startMs, time, text

description: Searches word-for-word passages from conference talk transcripts, by meaning. Each row has the session title, the speaker, the time into the talk (the time column, already formatted), and the sentence. Use it when no answered question covers the topic, or to quote what a speaker said.
